entities.summary: A Himmelsbrief, also known as a "heaven's letter" or "heavenly letter", is a religious document said to have been written by God or a divine agent. Their purpose is to protect the bearer or place from all evil and danger; however, there is a price for their protection. Himmelsbrief is a text. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
